name: previews
title: What You'll See: Five Promises
html:
What You’ll See: Five Promises

A real pull request on GitHub, through our gateway: data, links, forms, guards, merged.

The same kept script on a local GitLab, unchanged.

Think once with a model; every replay after, no model at all.

An API you know: AWS’s docs move into the answer as forms.

Claude Code through heart-mcp: one merge sent, the second refused before sending.

A later slide that keeps a promise carries its pill.
say: Five promises, so you know what's coming. A real merge on GitHub, through our gateway, step by step. Two forges: the same kept script on a local GitLab, unchanged. Zero tokens to replay. AWS forms: AWS's docs moving into the answer as forms. And an agent, Claude Code, given state instead of a catalogue, through heart-mcp. When a later slide keeps one of these, it carries the same pill, so you can see which promise it keeps. First, though, how the Web solved this for people, long before agents.
